title: Jubilant Jumping Norwegian Chickpeas Salad
description: A quick and easy Norwegian dish featuring hummus, this salad is a low-calorie friendly option for a snack or light meal, with a bouncy texture from the chickpeas.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the hummus, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and stir until they are fully coated with the hummus mixture.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Add the water to the bowl and stir until the salad has a creamy and bouncy texture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good stir and spoon it into a bento box or individual serving containers.
